# `schema_of_xml`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns schema in the DDL format of XML string.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
schema_of_xml(xml[, options])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `xml_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- schema_of_xml, example 1
> SELECT schema_of_xml('<p><a>1</a></p>');
STRUCT<a: BIGINT>
```

```sql
-- schema_of_xml, example 2
> SELECT schema_of_xml('<p><a attr="2">1</a><a>3</a></p>', map('excludeAttribute', 'true'));
STRUCT<a: ARRAY<BIGINT>>
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
